ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI uses your calendar to show, create and update your meetings and to schedule meeting alerts.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI uses your calendar to show, create and update your meetings and to schedule meeting alerts.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI lets you attach photos from your library to a meeting.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI lets you take a photo and attach it to a meeting.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI uses the microphone so you can speak to the assistant instead of typing.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Meeting Guard AI uses speech recognition to turn what you say into text for the assistant. You always see the text before anything happens.
